# Microsoft agent risk and governance: publication review

## Approved artifact

- Post: `astro-site/src/content/posts/2026-10-20-agent-risk-governance.mdx`.
- Visual: `astro-site/src/components/AgentEcosystemGovernance.astro`.
- Thor approved publication after reviewing the faithful six-column diagram and the revised “prompt books” framing.
- The article presents Thor's working guideline and directional risk judgment, with Microsoft's published risk tiers as supplementary context.

## Source fidelity and factual boundaries

The visual preserves six categories, builders, focus statements, examples, platform controls, audiences, authoring spectrum, purpose groups, identity boundary, risk progression, Agent 365 lifecycle/oversight, and four-part shared foundation. The initial replacement of the author's diagram with a vendor framework was rejected and removed.

Caption and platform notes distinguish reference labels from official risk scores, no separate Agent ID from no identity controls, Agent Builder's external-action boundary, Autopilots' overlap with Foundry, overlapping authoring methods, platform-specific enforcement, and MFA applicability. Eight public Microsoft Learn sources were retrieved; the citation ledger verifies supporting verbatim evidence for every cited source.

## Evidence and verification

- Independent Public Claims Researcher: official risk tiers, development zones, identity, product boundaries, and integration paths. Parent retrieved the load-bearing sources independently.
- Independent Presentation Reviewer: ACCEPT for the corrected six-column figure; every applicable score at least 92. Compared author source against desktop, laptop scrolling, and mobile. Static reference diagram, not a projection-stage deck.
- Desktop 1920px: six-column comparison. Laptop 1214px: labeled, focusable horizontal comparison. Mobile 390px and 360px: same data reflows vertically with explicit purpose and identity labels.
- Six categories, platform-control counts 4/5/5/5/5/5, four foundation areas. No page overflow, internal card clipping, or page JavaScript errors.
- Native platform notes work with pointer/touch and keyboard and without JavaScript under reduced motion.
- Ignored screenshot harness/evidence: `astro-site/.artifacts/agent-ecosystem*`. The named right-scroll screenshot captured an intermediate position; the reviewer independently verified the real endpoint. It is not retained as endpoint proof.
- Baseline: 58 production pages, 42 passing tests. Draft revision: 58 production pages, 43 passing tests. Parsed-frontmatter route/social-card tests now match draft exclusion, with a new draft-isolation test.
- Final prose before publication metadata change: 478 words, zero voice-lint issues; citation verification passed for eight sources. The six-column visual remained unchanged during voice revision.

## Publication boundary

Only this article, its visual, directly related tests, and this review belong to the release. Unrelated content worktrees and dependency pull requests are excluded. Final production build, pre-commit review, Pages deployment, canonical article, archive, RSS, and approved opening/visual readback are the publication gates. This approval does not authorize social syndication.
